task_description: Write a method in Dafny to set all even bits of a given number.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SetAllEvenBits(n: int) returns (result: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - In the output, all bits in positions corresponding to even indices are set to 1
- The bits in odd positions remain unchanged from the input number
- The result differs from the input number only in the even bit positions, which are now set to 1
